values: 一名星灵魔导士，能够通过星灵钥匙召唤异界星灵协助作战。
A Celestial Spirit Mage who can summon Celestial Spirits using Gate Keys to assist in battle.
よし！修行の成果見せてあげる！
Okay! I'll show you the results of my training!

values.source_text: よし！修行の成果見せてあげる！
values.text: 好！让你看看我修行的成果！
values.target_transcript: よし！修行の成果見せてあげる！

values: 開け！宝瓶宮の扉！アクエリアス！

values.source_text: 開け！宝瓶宮の扉！アクエリアス！
values.text: 打开吧，宝瓶宫之门！阿葵亚！
values.target_transcript: 開け！宝瓶宮の扉！アクエリアス！

values: 苦戦したけど、とりあえず勝利ね！
It was a tough fight but I won anyway.

values.source_text: 苦戦したけど、とりあえず勝利ね！
values.text: 虽然打得很艰难，但总算赢了！
values.target_transcript: 苦戦したけど、とりあえず勝利ね！

values: 私ルーシーよろしくね。
I'm Lucy! Nice to meet you!

values.source_text: 私、ルーシー。よろしくね。
values.target_transcript: 私ルーシーよろしくね。

values: フェアリーテイルが大好き。

values.source_text: フェアリーテイルが大好き。
values.text: 我最喜欢妖精的尾巴了。
values.target_transcript: フェアリーテイルが大好き。

values: 哇！我正准备想去买这个！好开心！
Whoa! I was just about to get this! This is awesome!
Wait... for real? You're giving this to me?
露西是一名星灵魔导士，可以通过星灵钥匙呼唤星灵，但不是所有的星灵都会对她言听计从，例如水瓶座阿葵亚。
Lucy is a Celestial Spirit Mage who uses Gate Keys to summon otherworldly beings known as celestial spirits. However, not all of them are eager to obey her commands, especially Aquarius.
除了黄道十二宫这种作战星灵外，露西还持有名为普鲁的赏玩星灵，因为它消耗的魔力不多，外形又可爱乖巧，所以深受露西喜爱。

Aside from the Zodiac spirits who aid her in battle, Lucy also owns a Nikora named Plue, who requires very little magical energy to summon. His adorable appearance and low energy cost make him one of Lucy's favorites.
露西对于众星灵都非常尊重温和，并且爱护他们，也因此受到大部分星灵的爱戴。
Lucy treats all celestial spirits with warmth, respect, and kindness. In return, they hold her in deep affection.
富裕家庭出身的露西没有选择奢华的生活，而是挣脱了上流社会的束缚，走上了自己钟爱的魔导士之路。
Though she comes from a wealthy family, Lucy left behind a life of luxury to forge her own path as a mage, free from the constraints of high society.
水瓶座阿葵亚是黄道十二宫中能力较强的星灵，虽然总能帮露西解决难缠的敌人，但阿葵亚的无差别攻击往往会带露西一起遭殃。
Aquarius, one of the most powerful Zodiac spirits, always helps Lucy face tough enemies. However, Aquarius' reckless attacks often end up hitting Lucy as well.
露西从小酷爱文学，但对自己的文学功底没自信，每当有人拿起她的手稿时，露西总是会紧张到面红耳赤。
Lucy has loved literature since she was young, but she lacks confidence in her writing. Whenever someone picks up her manuscripts, she can't help but blush with embarrassment.
露西的大部分工作动力来自她的房租压力，以及队友纳兹的巨额伙食费。
Most of Lucy's drive to work comes from her mounting rent bills and her partner Natsu's enormous food expenses.
露西的祖先与灭龙魔导士有着深厚的渊源。
Lucy's ancestors hold deep ties to Dragon Slayers.
露西飞踢是露西最强的技能之一，但必须与敌人近距离接触时才能发挥威力。
One of Lucy's most powerful moves, Lucy Kick, requires getting dangerously close to enemies to unleash its full potential.
作为星灵魔导士，和星灵处好关系非常辛苦，因为每个星灵都有较强的个性。露西曾在招待星灵阿葵亚时被要求出演短剧，不幸的是，演出全程都很冷场！

Managing relationships with spirits is no easy task, as each spirit has its own quirks and can be hard to please. For example, Lucy once performed a play for Aquarius, only to be met with crushing silence!
